title: The Golden Sheep
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Guitar-loving high-schooler Tsugu Miikura returns to her rural hometown and reunites with childhood friends Sora, Yuushin and Asari, with whom she buried a wish-filled time capsule. She finds the bonds have cracked: shy Sora is being bullied, and Yuushin is among those tormenting him (Kodansha blurb via AniList; MU; AIPT review of volume 1).
life_message: Friendship has to be fought for honestly as people change, and standing up for the bullied matters.

content.note: Bullying torment of Sora (AIPT); MU Boxing. Graphic level not reported.

folkways.japan: Reflects Japanese rural-hometown nostalgia and school ijime (bullying) dynamics, described here as context.
